rows.grounds: compound denoting worship and other related acts; object of kṛtvā
indeclinable indicating manner in accordance with what precedes
absolutive expressing completion of the act prior to the next
compound qualifying śatam as exceeding by eight
numeral indicating the count of recitations

items.question: What ritual actions and recitation count must follow the preceding preparatory measures?
premises: Worship and related acts are to be performed.
The performance is done in the manner previously indicated.
Recitation is to be completed a hundred and eight times.
items.inference: After the preceding preparation, one must perform worship and related acts and recite one hundred and eight times.
uncertainties: The specific acts included in arccana+ādi are not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having likewise performed worship and the other acts, and having recited one hundred and eight times.
